asXii v0.92
Tools M select · W magic wand · V move · T type · P pencil · B advanced brush · E eraser · U shape · K block · G fill · I picker · H hand · Z zoom; hold a tool's key to use it for a moment, let go to go back
Typing click with T, type; Enter = next line; Insert switches Overwrite / Insert; Esc leaves typing
Shapes while dragging: Shift = square / circle, Alt = from the center (pressed after you start), hold Space to move it
Select rectangle, ellipse, lasso or polygon (Shift M cycles), or the magic wand (W: the same character; Contiguous off = everywhere); Shift adds, Alt takes away, Shift + Alt keeps the overlap; drag inside or arrows move the outline; Ctrl + drag / Ctrl + arrows move the content (+ Alt: a copy)
Move drag moves what is selected (nothing selected = the whole layer); Alt + drag moves a copy; Shift locks it to one direction; Ctrl + click picks the layer under the pointer; Ctrl + Select moves too
Moving arrows nudge (Shift = 5); Enter drops it; Esc puts it back
Selection while one is active, Brush, Eraser and Type only change cells inside it; Ctrl D clears it
Shape rectangle, ellipse, line or polygon; Shift = square / circle / straight, Alt = from center; polygon: click points, click the first to close, Enter to finish open
Extrude (beta) select some art, then Extrude…: it gets depth (set across / down), shown live; Enter applies
Block drag to add 3D blocks (Alt / right-drag erases); Block size, Depth and Style; Bake makes them ASCII on a new layer
Paint Brush and Fill paint a character, noise (random from a set) or a repeating pattern
Drop white space is Clear (see-through); Shift Enter / Shift D drops it Solid, wiping what is under it (hold Shift to preview)
Draw Pencil = one character; Advanced brush = character, noise or pattern; [ and ] change the size; Shift-click draws a straight line from the last stroke; Alt-click picks a character; the right button paints the right-button character (Erase to start; Shift-click with the Picker sets it); the Eraser's right button erases only the brush character; Mirror paints a mirrored copy (drag the triangles at the ends of its lines to move them; Center puts them back; Flip characters turns / into \)
Fill Shift-click fills every matching cell (or the other way with Contiguous off)
Cursor the cell under the pointer is always highlighted (with Mirror on, its mirrored copies too, fainter)
View wheel scrolls, Ctrl + wheel zooms, Space + drag pans; Z zoom tool (Alt-click zooms out); + − 0 1
inside selection · Ctrl D clears
